{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column: is it really a string with commas?
print("First few values of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for the presence of commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()
print(f"\nDoes revenue contain commas? {has_commas}")

# Check the value of the internal test orders
internal_test_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of internal test orders: {len(internal_test_orders)}")
print("First few internal test orders:")
print(internal_test_orders.head())"}
